SNPs and lower AA and other omega-6 fatty acids relative to precursor LA. Similar results were found for the omega-3 series. Genetic
variation in the FADS1 and FADS2 gene cluster is important for the composition of fatty acids provided to breastfed infants in
mother's milk.
Genetic Variants in Omega-6 and Omega-3 Fatty Acids Metabolism and IQ
Children's intellectual development is inﬂuenced by both genetic and environmental experiences. Breastfed children attain higher
IQ scores than children not fed breast milk. Breastfeeding is thought to inﬂuence brain development through nutritional processes
